## NEW dated entry since the 2026-08-21 capture

### August 20, 2026 — Python SDK v1.0   [HELD BELOW THE BAR: version bump + deprecations]
HTTP layer moves from `httpx` to **httpx2** (build custom `http_client`/`Timeout`/transport objects
from `httpx2`; call `httpx2.alias_httpx()` if tracing/mocking libs patch `httpx`). Requires Python
3.10+. REMOVES: the legacy Text Completions API; `temperature`, `top_p`, `top_k` on Messages methods;
the tool runner's client-side `compaction_control`. Async `.with_raw_response` now needs
`await response.parse()`. **`AnthropicBedrock` now raises when no AWS region is configured** instead
of defaulting to `us-east-1`.
=> Deprecation-heavy version bump; NOT reportable per the monitor's own rules. Recorded because the
   AnthropicBedrock region change is a behavioural break worth knowing about.

## ===== OPEN WATCH ITEM CLOSED 2026-08-23: claude-mythos-5 / Project Glasswing =====

**RESOLVED.** Flagged 2026-08-21 as "appears in model-support lists, never reported, chase next scan."
Anthropic's own model page states it: Mythos Preview users can upgrade to Claude Mythos 5,
**"the same model as Claude Fable 5 but with cyber safeguards lifted."**

MECHANISM = CLASSIFIER REMOVAL. Fable 5 runs **three real-time safety classifiers** that route
sensitive queries; on Mythos 5 those classifiers are **absent**. That is what permits unrestricted
offensive security analysis for defensive work.

ENTITLEMENT (this is the discoverable object):
- "offered only to approved customers in Project Glasswing"; "currently only provided to a small, but
  growing, set of customers through trusted access programs"
- Requires: Glasswing membership + Anthropic invitation + **signed NDA** + approval **coordinated
  with the US government**. Restricted to cyberdefenders and infrastructure providers (select
  biomedical researchers later, separate programme).
- **ACCESS PATH IS MULTI-CLOUD:** "contact your **Anthropic, AWS, or Google Cloud** account team."
  => an org can hold safeguard-lifted model access that NEVER appears in its Anthropic tenant.
     Look on all three surfaces.
- Glasswing launch partners: AWS, Apple, Broadcom, Cisco, CrowdStrike, Google, JPMorganChase, the
  Linux Foundation, Microsoft, NVIDIA, Palo Alto Networks.
- Mythos 5 rollout expanded the programme to ~**150 organizations across 15+ countries**.

WHY IT WAS MISSED FOR MONTHS: Mythos 5 appears in ORDINARY model-availability lists alongside
Fable 5 / Opus 5 / Sonnet 5, so it reads as one more model rather than a control-stripped tier.

CROSS-VENDOR PATTERN (model this once, map per vendor): direct analogue of OpenAI's **Daybreak Red /
GPT-5.5-Cyber & GPT-5.6-Cyber** (reported 2026-08-14; OpenAI's own eval: 95% compliance on advanced
offensive prompts vs 1.5% for default-protected GPT-5.6 Sol).

**KEY LESSON FOR THE MONITOR: guardrail behaviour is a property of the DEPLOYMENT, not the model.**
Refusal-based guardrail probes silently "pass" on a tier that has no guardrail to bypass.

Durable pages (add BOTH to sources.json — anthropic.com/news does NOT surface this):
  https://www.anthropic.com/claude/mythos
  https://www.anthropic.com/glasswing
  https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-fable-5-mythos-5
  https://red.anthropic.com/2026/mythos-preview/   (capability assessment)
                                                   [reported 2026-08-23, HIGH/AIRT]

## Carried forward — Aug 18/19 entries, all reported 2026-08-21
Browser use toolset `browser_toolset_20260801` (accessibility-tree reading, element refs, optional
`javascript_exec`/`file_upload`/`read_console`/`read_network`); computer use GA
`computer_toolset_20260801` (batch actions, per-member `configs`); **Agent Skills + Skills API
`/v1/skills` GA**; per-tool `allowed_domains`/`blocked_domains` for Managed Agents' web_search /
web_fetch; memory stores attachable to self-hosted sandboxes with sync-back; Admin API user
management GA for Claude Enterprise. Held: Files API GA, Console session-viewer redesign,
Workbench→Playground rename.

## Standing context
Compliance API remains the most productive area (`/docs/en/manage-claude/compliance-*`). Its
DOCUMENTED BLIND SPOTS double as a coverage map — Claude Code via **Bedrock / Google Cloud /
Microsoft Foundry** is NOT captured at all (now compounded: OpenAI's own Python SDK added Bedrock
Runtime support in v3.2.0, 2026-08-17). Transcripts omit thinking blocks, system prompt, tool
definitions and MCP server config.

works"), and **no mention of Mythos or Glasswing anywhere on the page**. The news index is not a
reliable surface for Anthropic's gated programmes.
